question: How is the natural-order recitation of this mantra traditionally designated?
premises: The formula includes the address to the supreme goddess and svāhā
It should be recited in this very way
This manner in recitation is remembered as natural order
inference: Reciting the formula in this way is traditionally known as the natural-order recitation.
plain_english: One should recite 'O Supreme Goddess, svāhā' in this very way; in recitation this is remembered as the natural order.
